name: wayland-protocols
description: Collection of Wayland protocol extensions maintained by the Wayland project, required by Mesa and other Wayland compositors/clients for protocols beyond the Wayland core.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
